[EN] We can't save the dead, but we can end their torment. Take down the {@LinkCreature:8#4061#undying miners}.

Returning them to the Dream is the greatest gift we can offer them at this point.
[ES] No podemos salvar a los muertos, pero podemos acabar con su tormento. Derrota a los {@LinkCreature:8#4061#undying miners}.

Devolverlos al Dream es el mayor regalo que podemos ofrecerles en este punto.

[EN] It's our duty to end their suffering!
[ES] ¡Es nuestro deber acabar con su sufrimiento!
